enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.title: Enhanced Chat
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.chatEnhance: Quality-of-life chat improvements for Hypixel SkyBlock and general use.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.extendedCha: Increases the chat history limit from 100 to a configurable value.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.chatHistory: Maximum number of messages to keep in chat history.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.compactDupl: Merges repeated chat messages into a single line with a counter.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.compactIgno: Skips compacting messages that contain click events.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.onlyCompact: Only compact immediate repeats; any different message resets the counter.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.compactTime: How long to wait before resetting the compact counter. 0 = unlimited.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.enableChatT: Adds Hypixel channel tab buttons above the chat input.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.enableChatC: Right-click a message to copy or delete it.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.rightClickC: Bypass the menu and instantly copy raw text on right-click.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.enableChatS: Search through chat history with Ctrl+F.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.alwaysShowC: Keep the search field visible even when not actively searching.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.enableChatA: Smooth slide-up animation for new messages and the chat input bar.
enhanced_chat.midnightconfig.chatAnimati: How long the chat animation lasts.
